About Webbing 

Founded in early 2010, Webbing is a global data MVNO that delivers enterprise grade, global connectivity and IoT services across more than 200 countries and 600+ mobile carriers' networks. Webbing's secured network delivers network protection and web content intelligence.

Enterprise customers can manage, monitor, and optimize data usage in real-time with Webbing's powerful software platform. Gain visibility by application type and have the power to white list applications and limit non-business applications with the click of a button, saving money and improving compliance.

Description 

As part of the Webbing Core Network Team, you will be responsible for supporting, designing, and developing the Mobile Core network, with a focus on the CS and IMS domains (Voice, SMS, VoLTE).
This is an opportunity to demonstrate technical and organizational ability, working in a small team within the Webbing Network Engineering Department.

Responsibilities

  • Design and integrate new CS/IMS network elements and services into the production network, from solution design through testing and go-live
  • Prepare high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), interface specifications, and integration plans
  • Lead integration with internal elements, MNO partners, and vendors (SIGTRAN/SCTP links, SIP trunks, Diameter peers, SMPP connections)
  • Perform proactive analysis of network element KPIs, alarms, and network performance
  • Perform service and system testing, data collection, and optimization
  • Serve as the Level 3 escalation point for CS/IMS trouble tickets, including root cause analysis and resolution
  • Create and maintain network design and system documentation
  • Handle operational tasks and requests
  • Participate in knowledge transfer to various stakeholders
  • Provide 24x7 on-call support on a rotating basis

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of practical experience as a Core engineer in the CS and/or IMS domain
  • Complete familiarity with MNO/MVNO structure and end-to-end flows for Voice, SMS, and VoLTE
  • Strong knowledge of CS and IMS call and messaging flows, including registration, MO/MT call setup, SMS over CS and IMS, CSFB in roaming scenarios
  • Hands-on experience with CS/IMS elements such as MSC/MSS, HLR/HSS, STP/DRA, SMSC, P/I/S-CSCF, TAS, SBC/IBCF, and MRF
  • Deep understanding of MAP, CAMEL, ISUP, Diameter (Cx/Sh/S6a), SIP, RTP, and SMPP
  • Deep understanding of 3G, 4G, and VoLTE networks
  • Proven experience designing, scaling, and integrating network elements into a production network, including capacity planning and redundancy design
  • Hands-on experience integrating network elements (SIGTRAN/SCTP, SIP trunks, Diameter, SMPP)
  • Experience analyzing network flows using raw data (traces, PCAP, etc.)
  • Ability to analyze issues and designs against 3GPP standards and GSMA guidelines (e.g., IR.92, IR.65)
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to stay focused under pressure, including during live incidents
  • Willingness to travel occasionally

Advantages

  • Knowledge of IP switching and routing protocols
  • Knowledge of Linux system administration and cloud/virtualization technologies (AWS, VMware,K8s)
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation tools
  • Experience with IMS roaming (S8HR) or international voice/SMS interconnect

What we offer

  • An exciting and challenging workplace with great skill and knowledge development opportunities.
  • The opportunity to join a team of highly professional specialists in an international environment.
  • The opportunity for professional development within a reputable international innovative and growing company.
  • Meal Vouchers.
  • Medical insurance.
